CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Verification_URL__c), "Verification pending", HYPERLINK( "https://www.linkedin.com/profile/add?startTask=CERTIFICATION_NAME" & "&name=" & SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Course__r.Name, "&", "%26"), " ", "%20") & "&organizationName=TMS%20Academy" & "&issueYear=" & TEXT(YEAR(Issue_Date__c)) & "&issueMonth=" & TEXT(MONTH(Issue_Date__c)) & IF(ISBLANK(Expiry_Date__c), "", "&expirationYear=" & TEXT(YEAR(Expiry_Date__c)) & "&expirationMonth=" & TEXT(MONTH(Expiry_Date__c))) & "&certUrl=" & SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Verification_URL__c, ":", "%3A"), "/", "%2F"), "?", "%3F"), "=", "%3D") & "&certId=" & Name, "Add to LinkedIn profile", "_blank"))
CustomField.label: Add to LinkedIn
